explication: Handlebars.js is a JavaScript semantic-template engine. The main workflow is authoring a template and context, compiling the template to an executable function, then rendering output with registered helpers, partials, and runtime options. It also supports precompiling templates for faster startup, a standalone runtime for executing precompiled templates, escaping and safe strings, and guarded context-property access. Relationships within the compiler are limited where the excerpts do not show the invoking calls; the graph uses documented workflow links and indexed references where available.
